cobra_election.title: Elect COBRA (deadline)
cobra_election.detail: 60 days from the later of losing coverage or receiving the COBRA notice. Coverage is retroactive, so you can wait and elect only if you need care.

cobra_first_payment.title: First COBRA premium due
cobra_first_payment.detail: 45 days after you elect COBRA. Coverage is retroactive to the day your old coverage ended.

aca_sep.title: Marketplace enrollment window closes
aca_sep.detail: Losing job-based coverage opens a 60-day Special Enrollment Period at healthcare.gov.

spouse_sep.title: Join your spouse's employer plan
spouse_sep.detail: Employer plans must allow at least 30 days to enroll after you lose other coverage.

ui_file.title: File your unemployment claim
ui_file.detail: File in your first week out of work. Benefits generally start from the week you file, not the week you were laid off.

severance_sign.title: Severance agreement decision
severance_sign.detail: Date from your HR packet. If you are 40+, federal law (OWBPA) gives you at least 21 days (45 in a group layoff) to consider and 7 days to revoke after signing.

owbpa_group.title: Severance review period (age 40+, group layoff)
owbpa_group.detail: In a group layoff, workers 40+ get at least 45 days to consider a release, plus 7 days to revoke.

loan_401k.title: Repay your 401(k) loan to avoid tax
loan_401k.detail: An unpaid loan offset can be rolled over until your tax filing deadline, including extensions, for the year of the offset.

fsa_spend.title: Use your Health FSA balance
fsa_spend.detail: Health FSA coverage usually ends with your employment or at the end of that month. Check your plan's end date and claims run-out period.

aca_report_income.title: Report your new income to the Marketplace
aca_report_income.detail: Report income changes within 30 days. Since tax year 2026, excess advance subsidy must be repaid in full.
